strings.zh: 迷思 1：每天掉一點頭髮就是要禿了
strings.en: Myth 1: Daily hair shedding means you're going bald

strings.zh: 迷思 2：染髮 / 燙髮會讓我掉髮
strings.en: Myth 2: Hair dye and perming cause hair loss

strings.zh: 迷思 3：戴帽悶住 / 綁馬尾會讓人禿
strings.en: Myth 3: Wearing hats or ponytails causes baldness

strings.zh: 迷思 4：雄性禿吃中藥 / 喝何首烏 / 吃黑芝麻就會好
strings.en: Myth 4: Traditional Chinese medicine, He shou wu, or black sesame will cure male-pattern baldness

strings.zh: 迷思 5:Minoxidil 副作用很多，我不要用
strings.en: Myth 5: Minoxidil has too many side effects, I'll skip it

strings.zh: 迷思 6：圓禿（鬼剃頭）是壓力造成的
strings.en: Myth 6: Alopecia areata is caused by stress

strings.zh: 迷思 7：植髮一次就解決，跟原生一樣
strings.en: Myth 7: One hair transplant solves everything, just like natural hair

strings.zh: 結語 — 開始治療永遠不嫌早
strings.en: Bottom line — it's never too early to start treatment

strings.zh: 常見問題（PTT / Dcard 上常被問的）
strings.en: Common Questions (frequently asked on PTT / Dcard)

strings.zh: 落髮 PTT 推薦的洗髮精有用嗎？
strings.en: Are the shampoos recommended on PTT actually useful for hair loss?

strings.zh: 雄性禿吃 Finasteride 副作用很可怕嗎？
strings.en: Are the side effects of finasteride really that scary?

strings.zh: 雄性禿多久看得到效果？
strings.en: How long until you see finasteride/minoxidil results?

strings.zh: 植髮一次解決嗎？健保有嗎？
strings.en: Does a hair transplant solve everything in one go? Does NHI cover it?

strings.zh: 圓禿（鬼剃頭）會不會自己好？健保有給付什麼？
strings.en: Does alopecia areata heal on its own? What does NHI cover?

strings.zh: 男性雄性禿 Hamilton-Norwood 分級
例外：染髮劑過敏引發嚴重接觸性皮膚炎時，頭皮發炎可能造成局部暫時性掉髮 — 但這是另一個問題，不是染髮本身。
strings.en: Exception: severe contact dermatitis from hair-dye allergy can cause inflammation-related temporary local hair loss — but that's a different problem, not dyeing per se.

strings.zh: 處理：換成低張力髮型 / 放下來 / 換頻率。
strings.en: Management: switch to low-tension hairstyles / let it down / change frequency.

strings.zh: 嚴重時會擴及全頭（全禿 alopecia totalis)甚至全身（全身禿 alopecia universalis)
strings.en: Severe cases extend to alopecia totalis (entire scalp) or alopecia universalis (entire body)

strings.zh: 傳統治療：局部類固醇注射、外用類固醇、外用免疫療法(DPCP)— 對輕度仍有效
strings.en: Traditional treatments: intralesional steroids, topical steroids, topical immunotherapy (DPCP) — still effective for mild cases

strings.zh: 真正有實證的就那幾個

strings.en: Diagnosis-first, then treatment is most effective
How many strands fall during shampooing?
Is the scalp visibly showing through?

strings.zh: 不會傷毛囊、不會造成真正的「掉髮」
strings.en: does NOT damage follicles or cause true "hair loss"
Wearing a hat does NOT suffocate follicles

strings.zh: 真正會造成的是「拉扯性禿髮(Traction Alopecia)」
strings.en: What actually causes loss is traction alopecia

strings.zh: 雄性禿的根本是 DHT(雙氫睪固酮）讓毛囊微小化
strings.en: Male-pattern baldness is fundamentally driven by DHT-induced follicle miniaturization
no evidence for efficacy in androgenetic alopecia

strings.zh: 把休止期的舊髮推出去，讓新髮長出來
strings.en: pushes out old telogen hairs to make room for new growth

strings.zh: 停藥後幾個月內逐漸回到原本進度
strings.en: Returns to baseline within months of discontinuation

strings.zh: 2025 JAAD 共識：低劑量口服 Minoxidil(LDOM)安全用法 (Olsen 等)
strings.en: 2025 JAAD consensus on safe LDOM use (Olsen et al.)

strings.zh: 急性呼吸困難 / 新發胸痛 → 立即就醫評估
strings.en: Acute dyspnea / new chest pain → immediate medical evaluation

strings.zh: 多毛與療效無正比關係
strings.en: Hypertrichosis is not proportional to efficacy
Normal-appearing skin: no redness, pain, or itch

strings.zh: 沒同時用藥，後面照樣繼續禿
strings.en: Without concurrent medication, surrounding hair will continue to thin

strings.zh: 取髮區是後腦杓「永久區」
strings.en: The donor site (occipital scalp) is the "permanent zone"

strings.zh: 植髮不會阻止前面其他原生髮繼續細化、脫落
strings.en: Transplantation doesn't stop surrounding native hair from continuing to thin
the earlier you start, the better

strings.zh: 還在「細化中」的毛囊救得回來
strings.en: miniaturizing follicles can still be rescued

strings.zh: 外用 Minoxidil 5% 每天 1-2 次 + 口服 Finasteride 1 mg
strings.en: Topical minoxidil 5% 1–2x daily + oral finasteride 1 mg

strings.zh: 3-6 個月開始看到變化、6-12 個月達到最大效果
strings.en: Visible change in 3–6 months; peak effect in 6–12 months
fails to address the root cause of androgenetic alopecia
Alopecia areata diagnosis and management consensus

strings.zh: 戴帽會禿？Minoxidil 不能停？壓力會圓禿？
strings.en: Does hat-wearing cause baldness? Can you stop minoxidil? Does stress cause alopecia areata?

strings.zh: 外用 Minoxidil 5% + 口服 Finasteride 1 mg
同上 + 接受長期植髮計劃
低劑量口服 Minoxidil 0.25-1 mg、PRP、植髮
strings.en: Low-dose oral minoxidil 0.25–1 mg, PRP, hair transplant

strings.zh: 觀察 6-12 個月、補鐵、補蛋白質
strings.en: Observe 6–12 months; supplement iron and protein

strings.zh: 局部類固醇注射 / 外用類固醇
外用 Ruxolitinib、JAK 短期口服
strings.en: Topical ruxolitinib, short-course oral JAK inhibitors

strings.zh: 停止施力 / 改溫和染燙頻率
strings.en: Stop tension / reduce harsh styling frequency
